strings.jp: この地上に 暗黒をもたらし{n}  なんぴとからも いみきらわれし者{n}      その名は {arg}!{n}     しかし その{arg}も{n}    とこしえの 平和を ねがう{n} ゆうかんなる {arg}の 手により…{n}   ついに とわの ねむりにつき{n}      地上には ふたたび{n}   まばゆい光が みちあふれた!{n}    ひとびとは {arg}の名を{n}  えいえんに かたりつぐと ともに{n} あしき {arg}の たましいを………{n}   この地に ふういん せしめた!{n}{n}     ーー記・時のかたりべーー
strings.en: The one who brought darkness to this land,{n}  the one loathed by every soul,{n}      was named {arg}!{n}     But even that {arg},{n}    by the hand of the valiant {arg},{n} who wished for everlasting peace...{n}   at last fell into eternal sleep,{n}      and once again the land{n}   overflowed with dazzling light!{n}    The people, while forever{n}  passing down the name of {arg},{n} took the soul of wicked {arg}.........{n}   and sealed it in this land!{n}{n}     -- Recorded by the Teller of Time --
